- **Recovered rows can be stored out of order.** When the host later resumes a compaction child whose rows v0.30.1 recovered, and re-sends an earlier turn of that child with a changed timestamp or message ID, the recovered question and reply end up ahead of that re-sent turn in store order, instead of after it. Order only: the stored rows match v0.30.0's, with none lost or stored twice. Planned fix: v0.30.2 ([#2672](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2672)).

Duplicate attribution requires the recorded ingest route and both store IDs; restart replay also requires the restart record. Timestamp absence alone does not establish a cause.

Six more limits affect only what the model sees in its prompt or what search and recall return; they do not lose or copy a stored row.

- **Turns can drop out of the prompt after rejected summaries.** If two summaries in a row are rejected and the maintenance sweep runs out of time, compaction pauses for 600 seconds. While it pauses, turns that no summary covers yet can drop out of the model's prompt, and the end of the pause does not bring them back. They stay stored, and recall can still reach them. Fix release not yet set ([#2272](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2272)).
- **After a host restart, turns since the first compaction drop out of the model's view.** Only in a conversation that has a compaction child (Hermes's legacy rotating compaction, `compression.in_place: false`, now or earlier; the default in-place mode creates none): on Hermes v0.21.6 to v0.23.1 over ACP (by our reading of the source; not run on a release; seen on two pinned upstream builds), any restart of the host, clean or after a crash, resumes the conversation as it was before its first compaction. Turns since then are no longer sent to the model, and default recall (scoped to the current session) does not reach their raw rows. Their rows remain in LCM-X's store, except the rows of a turn interrupted by a hard kill, which are recovered at the next start of the conversation only with `LCM_HOST_ROW_RECOVERY_ENABLED=true` (#2624). This is a host defect, tracked upstream in NousResearch/hermes-agent#148047; v0.29.2 behaves the same. The #2624 recovery does not bring those turns back into the model's view, so this stays open ([#2626](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2626)).
- **`lcm_grep` searches only the first 512 KB of a saved tool output.** The rest of the file is kept but is not searched. Fix release not yet set ([#2518](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2518)).
- **A value that appears only in a tool call's input is not searchable.** The call is stored, but search does not find a value that appears only in its arguments. Fix release not yet set ([#2519](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2519)).
- **In a saved tool output, `lcm_grep` finds a query only where it appears word for word.** A quoted phrase, the same words in another order or one extra word finds nothing in a saved tool output, although message search matches such queries term by term. In the read-only MCP reader, hybrid and semantic modes do not search saved tool outputs in the default scope (an explicit `content_scope` is served by full-text search); use `mode='full_text'` there. The first part is fixed on main ([#2586](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2586), [PR #2587](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/2587)); the second is tracked in [#2592](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2592), with no fix release set yet.
- **A tool call's stored arguments can stop being valid JSON after a long base64 run.** When a tool call's arguments hold a long base64 run right after a `\n` escape, ingest moves the run to a payload file and takes the escape's letter with it, so the stored arguments are no longer valid JSON; ingest can also rewrite a JSON value held as text inside the arguments in compact form. Nothing is lost: expanding the placeholder gives back the original text. If compaction later puts that stored call back into the prompt (only when its arguments are 1,200 characters or fewer), Hermes replaces them with an empty object and logs a warning, so the model sees that one past call without its arguments. Fix release not yet set ([#2792](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2792)).

- **After a restart, a system message the store never held makes one already-stored tool call and its result be stored a second time.** Nothing is lost: the extra rows repeat the same call and result. It happens when the host's first view after a restart starts with a system message that LCM-X never stored. v0.30.0 behaves the same way. Fix release not yet set ([#2852](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/issues/2852)).

- **During a no-progress hold, the returned list can skip tool-pair repair.** A kept row can also retain cached content when its replay identity does not reflect a content change.

## Qualification

The v0.30.1-rc4 qualification record is pending. The earlier candidate's carry-forward decision applied only to v0.30.1-rc3.

- **M1, D1 LOCAL and D4/D8 — NOT RUN.** The final-candidate decision schedules these full recall comparisons for v0.30.2's first candidate and requires the final tag to clear its change-scope check, its 500-question D1 OFF tripwire with zero flips, and the 30-question D4 mini row.
- **D2, D3 and their prospective A/A — NOT RUN.** The prospective A/A preconditions are unresolved. The final-candidate decision calls for the reference agent's gate on copies of its conversations, including content walks, a compaction wall-time cell and a growth read, as the release gate for this omission.
- **D5 clone run — NOT RUN in the available qualification evidence.** The release rule schedules it for the first candidate cut after the #2647 preflight fixes merge and the runner passes its dry run. D5-B is a separate pair of controlled clone cells.
- **D9–D12 — NOT RUN as qualification rows.** They first gate on v0.30.2's first candidate. The reference-agent gate above uses its own predeclared measures.
- **D6 — NOT RUN apart from the OFF recall evidence selected under D1.** The other D6 rows were outside the selection. The same-store comparison and certifying driven run from the previous release kit were also outside this release's selection.
